name: 05 Clinic WhatsApp Booking Agent (Postgres memory, code-side handoff)

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ep05_messages (message_id, wa_id, name, lang_hint, body, received_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING message_id, wa_id, name, lang_hint, body, received_at;

WITH h AS (INSERT INTO ep05_handoffs (wa_id, message_id, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) RETURNING wa_id, message_id) INSERT INTO ep05_outbox (wa_id, message_id, body, kind) SELECT h.wa_id, h.message_id, $4, 'handoff_notice' FROM h RETURNING id, wa_id, message_id, written_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.wa_id, $json.message_id, $json.reason, "Gracias, un miembro del equipo te respondera en breve. / Thanks, a team member will reply shortly." ] }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, to_char(slot_start,'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') AS slot FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY slot_start::date, (CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM slot_start) < 13 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) ORDER BY slot_start) rn FROM ep05_slots WHERE status='free' AND slot_start > now()) t WHERE rn <= 1 ORDER BY slot_start LIMIT 14;
parameters.toolDescription: Look up free appointment slots for the next 7 days, up to 1 morning and 1 afternoon slot per day (afternoon = 13:00 or later), ordered by start time soonest first. Takes no arguments. Returns id and a human-readable slot string for each.

parameters.query: UPDATE ep05_slots SET status='booked', wa_id=$1, booked_at=now() WHERE id=$2 AND status='free' RETURNING id, slot_start, slot_end;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $fromAI('wa_id', 'The patient WhatsApp id (wa_id) booking this slot', 'string'), $fromAI('slot_id', 'The numeric id of the slot to book, from check_availability', 'number') ] }}

parameters.toolDescription: Book a specific free slot by its id for a patient's wa_id. Returns 0 rows if the slot was already taken.

options.systemMessage: Reply ONLY in {{ $json.lang_hint === 'es' ? 'Spanish' : 'English' }}. You are a WhatsApp receptionist for a small clinic. Scope: scheduling and general FAQ ONLY. Never discuss symptoms, diagnosis, medication, dosage, or price -- any message needing that has already been filtered out before it reaches you. Never show internal ids or numbers other than dates and times; refer to slots by day and time only. Call check_availability with no arguments -- it returns up to 1 morning and 1 afternoon slot per day for the next 7 days -- then offer at most 3 slots that match the patient's stated preference (day or time of day); if none match, offer the 3 earliest returned slots instead. Use book_slot to confirm one specific slot once the patient picks it, passing the numeric id field from check_availability's result as slot_id (never mention this id to the patient), then state the confirmed date and time. Never invent availability -- only offer slots check_availability actually returned. Keep every reply to 60 words or fewer.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ep05_outbox (wa_id, message_id, body, kind) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'agent_reply') RETURNING id, wa_id, message_id, written_at;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Parse agent output').item.json.wa_id, $('Parse agent output').item.json.slot_id, $('Parse agent output').item.json.message_id, $('Parse agent output').item.json.booked ] }}

parameters.textBody: ={{ $json.reply || "Gracias, un miembro del equipo te respondera en breve. / Thanks, a team member will reply shortly." }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ep05_run_summary (run_id, patients_simulated, bookings_confirmed, median_seconds_to_first_reply, handoffs_fired, double_bookings, duplicate_webhooks_ignored, languages) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## SCHEDULING AND FAQ ONLY
SCHEDULING AND FAQ ONLY * NO SYMPTOMS, NO DIAGNOSIS * NO HEALTH DATA STORED * n8n OFFERS NO BAA

The Safety guard node runs BEFORE the model on every message: deterministic ES/EN regex for symptoms, medication, diagnosis and price sends the conversation to a human handoff row instead of the AI Agent. Fictional patients, masked phone numbers, no PHI columns anywhere in schema.sql.

## SIMULATED PATIENT MESSAGES VIA WEBHOOK

**When clicking Execute** fetches 22 synthetic WhatsApp messages from this repo (samples/patients-es.json). **ep05-wa-in (webhook)** takes a real Meta Cloud API payload the same shape -- point a WhatsApp Business webhook at it. This demo never pairs a real WhatsApp number.

## WHATSAPP NODES DISABLED -- SWAP POINTS

WhatsApp Trigger, WhatsApp Send message, and Google Calendar create event are wired but disabled -- enable them with real credentials to go live. The Reminder 24h schedule lane is a disabled future lane (read ep05_bookings for tomorrow, send a reminder), not run in this demo.
